question: How do the fixed NK pathway associations depend on ranking by signed moderated t instead of released logFC?
decision: Describe ranking dependence across the same full pathway family and the three source-selected panels; do not rank new targets or reinterpret RNA as signaling.
strongest_rival: Fold-change ranking may privilege noisy large coefficients, while moderated-statistic ranking weights precision differently in only three pooled blocks.
discriminator: Replace only the rank statistic with signed moderated t from the unchanged S1 fit; preserve exact S2 genes, gene sets, seed, fgsea settings and serial backend.
exposure_record: All S1 contrasts, block stability and S2 enrichment/source comparison were inspected before this freeze. The original published outcomes and pathways are exposed; this is sensitivity, never independent confirmation.
biological_unit: Sorted pooled NK preparation/library; reported experimental replicate is a block.
nesting_and_overlap: Nine named libraries; constituent animal IDs, exact pool sizes and cross-assay animal reuse remain unknown. Replicate denotes experiment/day, not repeated mouse.
population_and_selection: All released NK input libraries and features from GSE287581 and pinned author commit 61ac9a440ba3f9db754ff8b8ad5008b450e647c0.
contrast: Source/sample qualification for ITDT minus PBS and ITDT+aCD4 minus ITDT, with the released third contrast retained for later replay.
endpoint: Pathway ES/NES direction, adjusted P, leading-edge overlap and full-family ranking differences.
methods: fgsea 1.26.0 with identical S2 memberships and AveExpr>1 universe; signed S1 moderated t sorted descending, no absolute-value ranking. Seed42 per contrast and original nPermSimple3000; SerialParam and CLI_NO_THREAD true. Independent weighted running-sum checks at absolute1e-8. Retain unestimated P/NES as null; do not increase permutations. No numerical robustness cutoff.
missingness_and_exclusions: No changed genes, pathways or samples relative to S2; reject universe mismatch and duplicate uppercase identifiers; retain every unfavorable or unestimated result.
multiplicity: BH correction within the full same Hallmark+KEGG family per contrast; source-selected panels remain exposed, with no new significance threshold.
precision_basis: Only three reported blocks and unknown animal membership; source-model P values are reproduced but no new population precision or biological power claim.
interpretation_limit: Reproduction of exposed pooled-library TPM transcript differences; not independent replication, count-based voom reconstruction, NK killing, secretion, signaling or mediation.
stop_rule: Fail universe, API or independent ES checks; no expansion if the fixed sensitivity cannot change interpretation.
amendment_reason: Separate signed-statistic sensitivity after source ES/NES, size and leading-edge agreement. Source Monte Carlo P values differ and remain an explicit exact-replay limit.
